page_title: DOR 4-2 BOC | Dortmund v Bochum 27/09/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+4' That's all for today as the game is over.
90+3' The ball sits up nicely on the edge of the box for Maximilian Wittek (Bochum), but his powerful first-time effort flies high over the bar.
90+1' Big chance! A simple pass from Julien Duranville left Serhou Guirassy (Dortmund) with just the keeper to beat inside the box, but his shot went agonisingly just past the left post.
90' We will have 3 min. of added time.
90' Dortmund seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. Great movement by the offensive players allows the defenders to set up the attack.

89' Nice move, nice attempt! Niklas Sule (Dortmund) is teed up with a simple pass after a nice flowing move. His first time shot from mid-range looks like it's going in but curls just wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Bochum.

87' POST! Emre Can (Dortmund) unleashes a thunderous effort from the edge of the box and the ball crashes against the left post. What a strike that was! The ball goes out of play and Bochum will have a goal kick.
86' Serhou Guirassy (Dortmund) commits a foul and Felix Brych immediately signals a free kick.
85' The Bochum players are exchanging some short passes to try and open up the opposition’s defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
83' Julien Duranville (Dortmund) goes for goal but he directs his effort just wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Bochum will have a goal kick.
82' Substitution. Niklas Sule (Dortmund) on for Yan Couto.
82' Peter Zeidler has decided to substitute Matus Bero and he is replaced by Aliou Balde (Bochum).
82' Today's match ends for Ibrahima Sissoko who will be replaced by Moritz-Broni Kwarteng (Bochum).
81' 4 - 2 Felix Nmecha (Dortmund) latches on to a brilliant pass and hits a poor shot towards the middle of the goal, but the ball goes into the back of the net after the goalkeeper makes a howler!
79' 8:6 – this is the current number of shots on target.
78' The attendance is 80000.
77' Wonderful movement by Dortmund. The players are holding possession, mostly exchanging one-touch passes. They control the pace of the game now.
75' 3 - 2 Goal! A great through ball by Karim Adeyemi sets up Serhou Guirassy (Dortmund) inside the box, and he makes no mistake and bangs the ball low into the middle of the goal. 3:2.
74' Here's the change. Julian Ryerson leaves the pitch and Ramy Bensebaini (Dortmund) comes on as a substitute.
74' Substitution. Felix Nmecha (Dortmund) in, Pascal Gross out.
74' Here is a change. Julian Brandt is going off and Nuri Sahin gives the last tactical orders to Maximilian Beier (Dortmund).
73' Emre Can (Dortmund) unleashes a shot, but his effort is poor and floats high over the bar.
72' That's the end of the game for Philipp Hofmann, who is replaced by Koji Miyoshi (Bochum).

69' Felix Passlack (Bochum) was standing in a clear offside position, making it an easy call for the linesman.
66' Jamie Gittens is not able to continue due to his injury and will be replaced by Julien Duranville (Dortmund).
65' Jamie Gittens (Dortmund) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.

64' Moritz Broschinski (Bochum) beats the defender inside the box and lashes a shot towards the bottom left corner, but Gregor Kobel makes a brilliant reflex save to deny him. Goalkeeping at its best!
62' Substitution. Moritz Broschinski (Bochum) receives a signal from the referee and is now allowed to enter the pitch as Myron Boadu walks off.
62' 2 - 2 Goal! Emre Can (Dortmund) wins the battle of wills and sends an unstoppable penalty past Patrick Drewes into the top left corner.
61' Emre Can (Dortmund) will take the responsibility and he is already preparing the ball.
60' Felix Brych blows the whistle, Felix Passlack (Bochum) is penalised for a foul. That's a penalty to Dortmund! They have a good chance to score now.
58' The referee can't ignore those comments and Yan Couto (Dortmund) sees a yellow card for bad language.
58' A quickly taken corner by Dortmund.

58' Dortmund are happy showing off their ball keeping skills and that is only interrupted when the defender steps in. The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Dortmund.

54' Long passes, short passes and one-two passes. Dortmund are showcasing great team work by keeping possession and producing pin-point passes from player to player. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult to intercept at the moment.
51' Dortmund failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
51' The ball is cleared after Emre Can (Dortmund) attempted to dribble past an opposing player. Dortmund will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
51' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Dortmund.

50' A big opportunity is wasted by Pascal Gross (Dortmund), who makes a yard for himself and produces a mid-range rocket of a shot towards the roof of the net. Unfortunately for him, Patrick Drewes pulls off a fantastic save to stop the effort. Dortmund win a corner.
49' Karim Adeyemi (Dortmund) makes a rough challenge and the referee blows for a foul.
47' Neat passing move from Dortmund in order to create new attacking opportunities.

45' There will be a minimum of 2 min. of added time.

36' Dortmund have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
36' Dortmund are enjoying possession, but one of the opposition players steps in to end the sequence. Now Dortmund have a corner.
34' None of the Dortmund players could reach the corner kick as the ball was overhit and goes out of play.

33' Myron Boadu (Bochum) receives a brilliant pass and wastes a big opportunity as his shot from inside the penalty area flies narrowly wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Dortmund will have a goal kick.
32' Dortmund are showing great team chemistry. They are passing it around beautifully. Excellent team work.
30' Karim Adeyemi (Dortmund) looks to break free, but his touch lets him down and he loses the ball. The ball goes out of play and Bochum will have a goal kick.
29' Julian Ryerson (Dortmund) makes a rough challenge and Felix Brych blows his whistle for a foul.
27' Pascal Gross (Dortmund) takes the corner, but one of the defenders reacts well and rises highest to head the ball away.
27' Jamie Gittens (Dortmund) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out. Dortmund have a corner.
26' Dortmund are bossing possession at the moment by exchanging some precise passes from player to player.

23' Jamie Gittens (Dortmund) delivers a low pass into the box which is intercepted. The ball goes out of play. Dortmund are awarded a corner kick.

15' Dortmund take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.

15' Julian Brandt (Dortmund) beats his marker and unleashes a thunderbolt of a shot from the edge of the box. Patrick Drewes sees the ball late but does well to stop it going inside the right post. Dortmund earn a corner.
14' The Dortmund players are exchanging some short passes.
11' Patrick Drewes pulls off a fantastic save! Karim Adeyemi (Dortmund) attempts to head home after a precise cross into the box. He aims his header towards the left post, but the effort is kept out.
10' Dortmund take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
10' Yan Couto (Dortmund) tries to send a pass but it's blocked. The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Dortmund.
9' The keeper makes a simple save after Felix Passlack (Bochum) received a short pass and shot low from the edge of the box towards the middle of the goal.
8' Julian Ryerson (Dortmund) nutmegs the defender on the edge of the box and lashes in a shot at goal that flies high over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Bochum.
7' Dani de Wit (Bochum) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Gregor Kobel, who smothers the ball.
6' Julian Brandt (Dortmund) is caught offside after the linesman raises his flag.
